profile.ja: 五車学園在籍の対魔忍。獣遁使いであり、龍の力を身に宿して戦う“龍化の術”を扱うことが出来る。獣遁・龍化の術により引き出した龍の魔力と、母親譲りの二刀流を組み合わせて戦う。龍の力は非常に強力であり、限界を超えた使い方をすると力に呑まれて龍に変貌してしまい、自分の意思では人に戻れなくなってしまう。暴走して周りを傷つけることを恐れるハイリは、獣遁の術を極めて力を制御すべく日々訓練に励んでいる。蛇化の獣遁を得意とする相州家の遠戚。母親も大蛇に変化出来る獣化忍であるのに関わらず、自分だけ龍に変化してしまうことに疑問を抱いている。物心ついた頃には父親の姿はなく、ずっと母親と二人暮らし。女手一つで育ててくれた母親のことは尊敬しているが、父親のことに関しては教えてもらえない。やや人見知りの傾向があり、表情もきつい為、初対面の人間からは怖がられることも多い。だが、心根は優しく面倒見が良いので後輩達からは慕われている。
profile.en: She is a Taimanin attending Gosha Academy, skilled in the art of beast transformation and capable of wielding the powerful "Dragon Transformation" technique. By combining her beast transformation abilities with her inherited dual-wielding skills, she fights using the dragon's magical power. However, the dragon's power is extremely potent, and if she exceeds her limits, she risks being consumed by the power and transforming into a dragon, losing her ability to revert back to human form. Fearing she might harm those around her, Hairi trains daily to master her beast transformation technique and control her power. As a distant relative of the Aishu family, known for their snake transformation abilities, Hairi is puzzled by her own ability to transform into a dragon. Having grown up without her father, she was raised by her mother and has a deep respect for her. Although she has a tendency to be shy around new people and has a stern expression, which often intimidates those who meet her for the first time, she has a kind heart and is well-liked by her juniors.

text.ja: 獣遁使い、竜宮ハイリよ。……なによ、まだなにか言えっていうの？　じゃあ、えっと……相州蛇子とは一応、遠縁の関係……とか？
text.en: I'm Hairi, a beast transformation user. What's up, do you need something? Well, I suppose I should mention that I'm distantly related to Aishu Hebiko...

text.ja: お母さんの家が、相州家の遠縁なの。うちも代々、獣化の術は蛇化する血筋みたい……あたしは、ちょっと……違うけど……
text.en: My family is a distant relative of the Aishu family. We're a family that's traditionally skilled in snake transformations... but I'm a bit of an oddity...

text.ja: あたしの獣遁は龍化の術……この身に龍の力を宿して戦うの。そんな力を持っていた人は、ご先祖様にもいなかったみたい
text.en: My beast transformation is a dragon transformation technique... I can harness the power of a dragon to fight. It seems that no one in my family has ever had this ability before.

text.ja: この力は、たぶん想像してるより何倍も強力で、何倍も恐ろしいものよ……だから、一日でも早く、制御できるようにならないと……
text.en: This power is probably many times stronger and more terrifying than you can imagine... so I need to learn to control it as soon as possible...

text.ja: ちょっと使うだけなら平気。ほら、こんな感じで……まだコントロールできるわ。限界を超えると、すぐ暴走しちゃうんだけどね
text.en: It's fine if I just use it a little. Like this... I can still control it. But if I exceed my limits, I'll lose control immediately.

text.ja: あの子……蛇子は――蛇じゃなくて、蛸の変化だけど……全然頓着してないわよね。そういうとこ、羨ましい……強いって、ああいうことなのかも
text.en: That girl, Aishu... she's not a snake, but an octopus... and she's completely carefree. I kind of envy her... maybe that's what it means to be strong...

text.ja: ……ひゃうっ！？　ちょっ、バカなのっ！？　尻尾に触らないでって言ってるでしょ！
text.en: Hya! Stop it! Don't touch my tail! I told you not to!

text.ja: それ以上近づくなっ！　勝手に尻尾触るようなやつは、半径５メートルに接近禁止！
text.en: Don't come any closer! Anyone who touches my tail without permission is banned from approaching me within a 5-meter radius!

text.ja: ……ちょっとくらいだったら、触ってもいいわよ。で、でも、優しくよっいいっ？　その、だからっ……あ、アソコに、触るくらい、優しくっ……
text.en: It's okay if you touch it a little... but be gentle, okay? So, don't... touch it carelessly, okay?

text.ja: はぁっ、んっ、んぅぅっ……だ、めぇ……もっと、ゆっくり……激しく扱いちゃ、やだからねっ……あんっ、やっ、そこぉっ……
text.en: Haa... nn... nuu... stop it... go slower... if you're too rough, it's no good...
